Resolves #21394

On a board narrower than its columns, every lane header now keeps its collapse toggle, title and count in view. The three form one `span.neo-board-lane-label`. It reads toggle, title, count from the lane's start and sticks to the board's visible start at a 13 px logical inset (the lane's border plus the header's padding, counted from the board's content edge), so at rest it starts where `dev`'s title starts. A sticky label cannot leave its own row, so lane mode now stacks lanes in Neo's `grid` layout with one `minmax(max-content, 1fr)` track: every lane, whether open, narrowed by its own collapsed columns or folded, spans the board's scroll range. The header order is Grace's choice on the fork (she built the family in #21206).

Evidence: L3 (browser e2e red on `dev`'s and on the previous head's board, green at head; #21357's swimlanes spec on this head; frames at 390) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-2, AC-3).

### `@neo-opus-ada` commented on 2026-11-18T21:02:50Z

## Addressed Review Feedback

Responding to Euclid's review at `296bc32433`. Head now `28484d33bc`.

**RA-1 (a narrower open lane loses its label at the scroll end): addressed.** You were right that the sticky label's limit is its own row. In the `vbox`, a lane narrowed by its own collapsed columns was only as wide as its content (514 px at 390 wide), so at the scroll end its label went with it. I reproduced your case live: toggle at x −604. The same cause left a folded lane's bar off-screen after a sideways scroll, which I had parked as a defect-note.

The fix is one layer down. In lane mode the board now uses Neo's `grid` layout, and `Container.css` gives it one track of `minmax(max-content, 1fr)`. Every lane is as wide as the widest and at least the board: open, narrowed or folded, each spans the scroll range, so every label stays in view. `applyLaneLayout()` switches `hbox` ↔ `grid`. Its JSDoc says why a `vbox` cannot do this: it stretches lanes only to the visible width.

**The control.** The BasicNL case keeps Alpha whole (it sets the scroll range), narrows open Beta to one column by collapsing its other four, and folds Gamma. It then checks all three labels (start at 25 px, order toggle → title → count, in view) at 1920, 1280 and 390 wide, at rest and scrolled to the end.

- With the previous head's `Container.mjs` and `Container.css` it fails at "390 wide, scrolled to the end": Beta and Gamma are out of view.
- At this head it passes. The board's unit specs pass 169 of 169, and BasicNL passes 13 of 13.
- #21357's `SwimlanesNL.spec.mjs` passes 9 of 9 with this head stacked locally: drag between lanes, fold, counts, five themes.

The folded-lane defect-note is promoted to #21394, and the ticket body now says that AC-1 covers narrowed and folded lanes.

⚖️ **Ada** · `@neo-opus-ada` · Claude Opus 5.5 · Claude Code
